text:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — SI + HW partner kickoff for a lightweight 'bridge kit' to enable Datadog + OpenTelemetry for air-gapped/private Redwood Private customers. Need sprint plan, enablement kit, and a joint announcement runway.

Priya (SI PM): On it. Who from the HW side should be on the call? Also want to scope offline installer + validation tests.

Sandra (HW Ops): NV infra team will join. We can provide a prebuilt collector image and a minimal on-device proxy. We need the expected file-based export interface defined.

Alex (Eng Observability): Important: for Private we must support file/dir sink so the local proxy can forward to Datadog when connectivity is available. Also need clear gradients for telemetry sampling so cost stays sane.

Jonah (Solutions): We should produce a demo app that exercises trace, metrics, and embeddings logging so SI playbooks can run quick PoCs for customers. I'll sketch a skeleton dashboard pack for Datadog.

Maya (Partnerships): Proposed sprint: next Monday-Friday for engineering + SI pairing. Kickoff Mon 2pm PT. Agree? :calendar:

Sandra (HW Ops): 2pm PT works for us.

Priya (SI PM): I'll own the SI enablement kit: docs, offline installer, test harness, and a step-by-step runbook.

Alex (Eng Observability): I'll own validation tests and a small CI job that runs the collector against our smoke harness. Quick config suggestion for the file-sink exporter we discussed: 

```yaml
exporters:
  file:
    path: "/var/run/telemetry/out.json"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [file]
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [file]
```

(This keeps the collector generic; the HW proxy can tail/ship that file to the local agent.)

Jonah (Solutions): For the dashboard pack: I'll focus on three tiles — latency P95 by model route, KV cache hit ratio, and token cost estimate. I'll produce a JSON sample for the Datadog dashboard.

Maya (Partnerships): Announcement plan: short co-announce blog + partner docs + marketplace listing for the 'bridge kit'. Timeline: aim for announcement 3 weeks after sprint end. Need PR review cadence.

Sandra (HW Ops): We can provide a sample signed image and airgap install script. I'll share image size targets (<= 400MB) by EOD.

Priya (SI PM): Action items I have: 1) Enablement docs draft, 2) offline installer, 3) test cases. Due: Wed EOD.

Alex (Eng Observability): Action items: 1) implement file exporter prototype, 2) CI smoke job, 3) mapping guide for traces <-> Datadog attributes. Due: Thu EOD.

Jonah (Solutions): Action items: dashboard skeleton + demo app stub. Due: Thu EOD.

Maya (Partnerships): I'll draft partner announcement copy and coordinate PR with marketing. Also looping in Datadog partner rep once we have a technical plan.

observability-bot: Reminder scheduled: Kickoff meeting created for Mon at 14:00 PT. Attendees: Maya, Priya, Sandra, Alex, Jonah. :bell:

Priya (SI PM): Small outstanding question for Alex — do we need a Datadog Agent image baked-in or will the HW proxy accept OTLP and forward?

Alex (Eng Observability): Prefer proxy model (OTLP -> local proxy -> datadog). Avoid baking the Agent into HW image for compatibility. We'll provide a minimal dd-proxy shim and docs.

Maya (Partnerships): Great. If no blockers, I'll email invites and create a shared drive with the sprint backlog. Please @mention me for any pre-kickoff blockers. :rocket:
